notes.title: Build V0.6.61 - Patch Note
notes.notes:
- Added difficulty levels (easy, normal, hard, legendary).
- Added nitro to the starting car.
- Added acceleration effect.
- Fixed localization errors.
- Added hints to the loading screen.
- Added new abilities: energy shield and strafe.
- We worked on the AI of rivals.
- Disabled the second dialogue with Cassie in the garage at the first entrance.

notes.title: Update - Build V0.6.14
notes.notes:
Update - Build V0.6.14
- Added the ability to select a car at the start of a New game.
- UI editing.
- Reduced time dilation when crossing the event start point.
- Fixed a bug with late clicking on the event activation button.
- Fixed a bug with no music in the main menu when starting the game from the gamepad.
- Fixed a bug with the inability to select an event on a large map.
- Fixed localization errors.
- Made minimap rotation with the player.
- Redesigned the city.
- Fixed a bug with the car respawn after a breakdown.
- Improved the AI ​​of the top traffic.
- Changed the angle and position of the player's camera.
- Added vibration for the gamepad.
- Added weather conditions.
